chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Musa ibn al-Hasan, from al-Haytham ibn Abi Masruq, from a shaykh of our companions known by the teknonym Abu Abdillah, from a man, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

The Messenger of God (may God's blessings be upon him and his family) said: 'Fever is the harbinger of death, the prison of God the Exalted in His earth, and its outburst is from Hell, and it is the share of every believer from the Fire.'

key_terms.الحمى: Fever; here given an eschatological dimension as a form of divine punishment substituted for hellfire
key_terms.حظ: Share, portion, allotment; the believer's earthly suffering 'uses up' their share of hellfire
key_terms.رائد الموت: Harbinger/forerunner of death; the fever is a sign and prelude of death's approach
key_terms.سجن الله: Prison of God; the illness confines and disciplines the believer
key_terms.فور: Boiling, outburst, bubbling up; refers to the intense heat of fever echoing hellfire

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about the spiritual meaning of fever in Islam?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) transmits a saying of the Prophet (SAWW) explaining the nature and spiritual significance of fever. The Prophet describes fever as a 'harbinger of death,' a divine prison in this world, and connects its intensity to the heat of Hell. Crucially, fever is identified as the believer's 'share' from the Fire — meaning that through illness in this world, the faithful are purged of sins that would otherwise require punishment in the Hereafter.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Musa Bin Al Hassan, from Al Haysam Bin Abu Masrouq, from a Sheykh from our companions teknonymed with Abu Abdullah, from a man, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The fever is a harbinger of death, and a prison of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> the Exalted in His<sup>azwj</sup> earth, and its outburst is from Hell, and it is a share of every Believer from the Fire (of Hell)’.
en.sarwar: 7. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Musa ibn al-FIassan from al-Haytham ibn al-Masruq from a shaykh of our people called abu ‘Abd Allah from a man who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah has said, ‘
Fever is a harbinger of death and a prison of Allah on earth. Its heat is from hell and that is the share of a believing person (instead) of hellfire.’”
